verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production environment for Scribe. Zero-retention mode (enable_logging=false) and single-use auth tokens are adjacent data-handling and auth controls, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
